none.message: No cycle is open. A human starts one with ./tdd red "<behaviour>" in the gate terminal; until then src/ and tests/ are frozen.

red.message: Phase is RED: write one failing test. src/ is frozen until the humans run ./tdd green.

green.message: Tests are frozen in GREEN. If a test is wrong, the group must decide to return to RED.

refactor.message: Tests are frozen in REFACTOR. Improve the code; the tests define what must not change.
